signals.title: Jeffsville informal settlement, Atteridgeville (map point approximate): nine people shot dead inside a shack, night of 15 Nov
signals.content: Nine people, six men and three women, were found shot dead inside a four-roomed shack at the Jeffsville informal settlement in Atteridgeville, west of Pretoria, on the morning of Monday 16 November, Gauteng police told the Mail & Guardian and IOL. Police believe they were shot between 10pm and 11pm on Sunday 15 November. A child who came to ask for money for school found the bodies, Gauteng Police Commissioner Lt-Gen Tommy Mthombeni said. The motive is not known and no arrests had been reported; the Serious and Violent Crimes, Murder and Robbery Unit is investigating. The map point is approximate: the Atteridgeville area point, not the shack.
